lessons_used: Reordering sign-in earlier (after adoption selection or photo upload) and adding targeted sign-in clarification hints were helpful, but placing sign-in after the adoption certificate severely degraded conversion (-22.4%).

Adding specific interactive or setup-focused new screens (Visibility Check, Interactive Welcome, Sound Calibration, Pet Personality Intro) was helpful, whereas multi-step setup flows (System Tray flow, Sound Verification flow) hurt conversion.

Select layout redesigns (Stage adoption, Story scroll/stage/grid, Checklist intro) won, but redesigning photo upload layouts (Grid, Card, Split Pick Friend) and waiting screen spotlight severely hurt conversion (down to -23.3%).
Most audio cues, progress bars, tip carousels, notification enable toggles, and standalone headline updates showed no clear effect.
Predictions were overly optimistic for non-winning changes, predicting gains up to +12.0% on features that showed no clear effect or caused severe drops.
Predictions were frequently too low or negative (down to -8.0%) for winning features that delivered large positive impacts (up to +14.0%).

candidates.title: New Companion Desktop Shortcuts Screen
candidates.change: Add a new desktop controls overview screen before completing onboarding that details keyboard shortcuts and system tray controls.
candidates.why: Support received multiple complaints from users who were confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their desktop pet after completing setup.

new_companion_desktop_shortcuts.headline: Desktop Companion Quick Controls
new_companion_desktop_shortcuts.body: Use double-click to chat with your companion, drag to move them across your desktop, and right-click for full controls.

guard.reason: Adding a new desktop shortcuts overview screen inside onboarding is allowed and preserves all required steps.

candidates.score_note: High finish drop with matching support complaints; interactive setup screens consistently perform well.

candidates.title: Carousel Layout Redesign for Choose Path Screen
candidates.change: Redesign the choose path screen using a clean carousel layout to highlight each companion path option individually.
candidates.why: Choose path has a median duration of 8s but a mean of 514s, indicating that some users hesitate or get confused by the layout.

guard.reason: Redesigning the choose path layout as a carousel retains its functionality without breaking any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Target step drop is small and supported only by time data, but redesigns on choose_path average +2.3%.

candidates.title: New Pet Account Link Confirmation Screen
candidates.change: Add a new account link confirmation screen immediately after signing in, reassuring users that pet save files are attached to their login.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in; explicit confirmation immediately post-login builds trust.

new_pet_account_link_confirmation.headline: Account & Pet Memory Synced
new_pet_account_link_confirmation.body: Your pet customizations and adoption data are tied to this account. Logging back in with these credentials will always restore your pet.

guard.reason: screen 'new_pet_account_link_confirmation' is not part of onboarding (new screens are named new_..., and may not look like payment, account, sign-up or settings screens)

candidates.title: Checklist Layout Redesign for Adoption Certificate Screen
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to use a checklist layout summarizing companion details and verification status.
candidates.why: Adoption is the largest drop-off point in the funnel (80.1% conversion, mean 1017s); a structured checklist layout makes certificate review clear and concise.

guard.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate into a checklist layout loses the required job of showing an official adoption certificate with a stamp.

candidates.title: Sign-In Multi Device Account Persistence Hint
candidates.change: Add a clear hint on the sign-in screen informing users that signing in preserves pet identity and save state across sessions.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets cited pets disappearing or resetting after re-login; reinforcing account persistence at sign-in addresses this fear.

sign_in.hint: Signing in binds your companion's personality, memories, and custom traits securely to your account.

guard.reason: Adding an informational hint to the sign-in screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Directly supported by 8 tickets, cheap config update, and sign-in hints have proven positive impact (+2.5%).

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Graphic Loading Note
candidates.change: Add a desktop graphic loading note on the waiting screen explaining that local desktop rendering engines and pet graphics are initializing.
candidates.why: Home waiting time is very high (median 201s / mean 2336s) and 3 users reported pets failing to show on desktop upon initial launch.

waiting.hint: Initializing desktop pet renderer and local asset cache. Your companion will appear directly on your screen shortly.

guard.reason: Adding graphic initialization info to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high wait time and loading complaints; wait_info historically shows modest gains (+1.3%).

candidates.title: Home Intro Companion Trait Calibration Hint
candidates.change: Add a helpful hint on the home intro screen explaining where to find pet controls and behavior preferences.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails expressed confusion on how to control or hide the pet post-onboarding.

home_intro.hint: Your companion roams freely on screen. Access behavior settings and visibility options anytime via the system tray icon.

guard.reason: Adding a behavior settings hint to the home intro overlay is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High drop step and support complaints, but historical data shows finish hints yield slightly negative results (-0.4%).

candidates.title: Reorder Sign-In After Pick Friend
candidates.change: Move sign-in to take place immediately after picking a pet friend, letting users choose their pet before creating or linking an account.
candidates.why: Earlier lessons showed moving sign-in later improved adoption motivation, and placing it right after pet selection leverages emotional attachment.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to take place after pick friend is explicitly allowed by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in has consistently degraded conversion (-4.5% overall) with no support mail backing.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Companion Archetype Headline Clarification
candidates.change: Update the main headline on the pick friend screen to emphasize selecting a companion archetype.
candidates.why: The adoption stage drops to 80.1% conversion; framing the pet selection clearly encourages decisive progression.

guard.reason: Updating the headline on the pick friend screen retains its core function.

candidates.score_note: High adoption drop step, but standalone headline updates show no clear historical effect.

candidates.title: Choose Path Quick Companion Overview Hint
candidates.change: Add an explanatory hint on the choose path screen summarizing the difference between standard preset pets and custom creations.
candidates.why: Choose path has a high mean time of 514s, indicating that users pause when choosing between setup options.

choose_path.hint: Select standard companion for instant setup, or photo journey to generate a personalized custom pet.

guard.reason: Adding an explanatory hint to the choose path screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Low step drop but choose_path hints have strong historical performance (+2.8%) at minimal cost.

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in earlier (after photo upload or adoption selection) and specific sign-in hints/copy won, whereas placing sign-in after the adoption certificate severely hurt conversion (-22.4%).
Adding focused individual screens (Interactive Welcome, Sound Calibration, Pet Personality Intro, Visibility Check) won, while multi-step setup flows consistently degraded conversion.

Select layout redesigns won (Stage adoption, Story scroll/stage, Choose Path grid/carousel, Checklist intro), but photo upload layout redesigns and waiting screen spotlight severely hurt conversion (down to -23.3%).
Targeted notification prompts, desktop activity hints, and interaction hints won, while most audio cues, progress bars, tip carousels, and standalone headline updates showed no clear effect.
Predictions were overly pessimistic for major winning features, predicting negative or small gains (e.g., -8.0% or -0.2%) for changes that delivered up to +14.0% improvements.
Predictions were overly optimistic for non-winning changes, forecasting gains up to +12.0% on interventions that showed no clear effect or caused drops.
